retina.title: Native resolution (Wine Retina mode)
retina.description: Render at the display's physical resolution instead of its point size, which macOS then upscales: 3840x2160 instead of 1920x1080 on a 4K panel at the default scaling. The interface looks half as large.

srgb.title: Colour-managed output (sRGB)
srgb.description: mtld3d tags frames as sRGB (color.space = accurate), so a wide-gamut panel shows the art's intended hues instead of stretching them to the panel's gamut.

textures.title: Texture pack
textures.description: Pack files from archives you downloaded (e.g. Sqeak's DAoC Textures) over the client's folders. Off keeps the pack aside and puts the original files back.
